_comment: Texture upgrades: a converted Frontline texture is replaced by a texture the mod ALREADY ships (nothing new is shipped or downloaded) only where that texture is clearly better (sharper, higher resolution, no upscale artefacts) and fits the look. Keys are the converter's texture names (level -> short key). tc_scale keeps the world size of the pattern (Frontline stones per metre). Frontline's baked vertex lighting stays on top (rgbGen vertex). Never signs or lettering. Reviewed by eye: docs/proposals/frontline_study_2026-11-08 (texture pass).

10d700.reason: main town street (3183 floor tris): Frontline 128px dark mossy granite setts; HD Project cobblestone2 is 1024px, same mossy setts look, no artefacts; scaled 1.6x so the stones keep Frontline's size

1dd980.reason: [look 2026-11-13, user-approved 'Yes upgrade'] the mod's own HD stock tree card (Pak2 path; the HD foliage pak draws it at 1024 px), cut-out kept, graded to the disc card's mean colour on its solid texels

1_1._upscale_foliage: [flfix2 round 19c] opaque dense-foliage textures: ESRGAN leaf detail is real here, the worm limit is the cards' 2.5x (the hedge box 16c480, back to the disc art by user decision 2026-11-13)
1_1._plaintext_doc: [careful-upscale sheet 2026-11-15] the coin c2_138800 read slightly swirlier with even 20 % ESRGAN detail: a plain enlargement (careful_up share 0). Every other held-back texture and every lettered sheet takes the careful 4x (letters checked one by one)
1_1._nosoft_doc: [QA sheet 2026-11-15] the soft retry made these worse side by side (wheel and coin swirls, invented pebbles on plaster a5000 / c2_e7c00 / c4_e7200 / c2_fc300, holes 123b80, sparkle on the bomb, a stripe on c2_143c00): they keep the disc texture. The cigar-box label and letter, the Renault sign and the Balkenkreuz went to noupscale (text and insignia)
1_1._noupscale_reason: road signs 'Periers 7km' / '30 Km a l'heure' and the 'Le Consortium' poster: lettering - Frontline's own pixels are kept (no ESRGAN on text); [flfix2 look 2026-11-12] plus every lettered sheet found on the contact sheet of the ESRGAN pass: Cherbourg / Paris direction signs, BOULANGERIE, HALT, D-789, BAZAR DE VARZY, MERCERIE, CORDON-GIRARDOT, HUILES RENAULT, VINS LIQUEURS, ENERGOL, ANTIQUITE, the 718 / 987 / 45 224 numbers, the U-boat, jeep and P-47 markings

1_3._doc: [anvil 1_3 HD, v1.10.92] Anchor & Anvil: every lettered / numbered / insignia / photo sheet found on the full 537-texture contact sheet is held back from the full ESRGAN pass: 'noupscale' keys take the careful 4x (Lanczos + light unsharp + 20 % ESRGAN detail, held to the source's local range); 'plaintext' (stencilled digits, plates, typewriter keys, dials, the note and blueprint) takes the plain careful enlargement with no ESRGAN at all; 'keepdisc' = the converter's own journal pages (already 1024 px text). Big homogeneous materials are CC0 swaps (hd/swaps_look.json 1_3).
